message: So, I was thinking about how we all have that one drawer in the kitchen that’s just a chaotic mix of everything, right? 😅 Well, what if our approach to fire safety was just as haphazard? I stumbled upon some great resources from the NFPA that remind us to get our fire safety game on point—because finding a fire extinguisher in a panic is not the comedy special we want to star in! Let’s be a bit more prepared, shall we?
